'''R2-S8''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid]] with [[Color|white]], black and red plating and a black [[sensor]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> Like all [[R-series|R2]] [[astromech droid]]s, it stood 93 [[centimeter]]s tall<ref name="AEYNTK:UE" /> and was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="R-series note" /> In [[13 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on [[Corellia]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', which includes R2-S8's appearance, to 6 [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]], therefore the events on Corellia must take place in [[13 BBY]].</ref> R2-S8 was present in [[Coronet City Spaceport|Coronet Spaceport]] in [[Coronet City]] on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]]. Following a breach of the customs gates causing a security alert in the [[spaceport]], R2-S8 was displaying a blue [[hologram]] from its [[holoprojector]] for a pair of [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy Trooper|Fleet Troopers]] when a nearby family of [[human]]s was forcefully separated by [[stormtrooper]]s.<ref name="Solo" />

==Behind the scenes==
R2-S8 was created for the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology film]], ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo" /> The droid was first revealed prior to the film's release as part of a [[Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|''Star Wars: Droid Factory'']] toy set produced by [[Hasbro]] earlier in 2018.<ref name="RS-news">{{Rebelscum|url=story/front/New_Disney_Parks_Droid_Factory_Astromech_Set_Is_Out_180403.asp|text=New Disney Parks Droid Factory Astromech Set Is Out|author=David Martin|date=2018-04-04|archivedate=20180916100343}}</ref>
